Create ONE seamless spherical architectural 360x180 degree EQUIRECTANGULAR panorama for an interactive real estate virtual tour. Exact 2:1 image aspect ratio; maximum available resolution. Correct equirectangular latitude/longitude projection, horizon at half image height; topmost row is directly upward ceiling/sky, bottommost row directly downward floor; left and right image edges represent SAME direction and must join perfectly with identical colors and architectural lines. Use neutral blank wall at seam. Camera height 1.60 m at one point in the room. Show all sides of the room once, including the wall behind the camera. NO perspective wide-photo, NO collage, NO panels, no text/logos/arrows/watermark. Photorealistic Brazilian contemporary interior, sunlight, believable proportions. Keep the exact materials, furniture, window and door styles and skyline from the reference board. Reference 1 is plan geometry, reference 2 the six room interiors; references serve continuity, do NOT reproduce them as a board. The plan description below is for spatial context ONLY: final output must be an eye-level full spherical panorama and MUST NOT be a top-down plan.

Same room doors and flooring as reference board; living/dining visible at one end, master bedroom doorway and other bedroom/shared-bath doors at opposite end. Logical floorplan arrangement, no extra corridors. Full all-surroundings 360.
